scope: Independent single-event snapshot revalidation; no source-event detection, chronology, cumulative state or production admission
generation_rule: Generate fresh numeric values, row choices, source labels and unknown-field names only after the code, this requirements file and generator are hash-frozen. Save expected states and case hashes before execution.
policies: Each supported event kind has an explicit top-level field allowlist.
Unknown or kind-incompatible fields hold with no numerical result, even if apparently harmless.
Correction events cannot carry source_id or covariance fields; these require upstream source/dependence qualification and a supported event representation.
The legacy optional no_change source_id is accepted only for an explicitly declared background source; arbitrary source identities hold.
Malformed replacement pairs reject; arbitrary event objects or unsupported kinds hold.
Every output states independent snapshot semantics and cumulative_history=false.
Explicit sequential or other batch mode holds without evaluating events.
Existing fresh purpose, packet identity, rights and execution-authority controls remain in force.
No output grants commercial acceptance or production admission. Semantic holds are control outcomes only.
regression_rule: Replay all original 64 saved events and mission mutations against their original packets. Preserve prior expected statuses and numerical results within 2e-6; old data are not new confirmation.
numeric_rule: Fresh eligible updates must match an independently applied update and analytic REML score-equation solution within 2e-6 for k, estimate, se, tau2 and normal interval bounds.
acceptance: All fresh declared conformance cases and all 64 regressions conform; all hold/reject outputs omit numerical results; every output preserves no commercial/production admission; frozen v1 and recipient bytes remain unchanged.
limits: Bounded generated cases do not estimate real-world reliability or validate unmodeled event semantics.
No fresh recipient transfer of v1.1 is tested.
No cumulative ledger, source monitoring, cryptographic mission authority or scientific validity is added.
A caller still supplies an already qualified snapshot, scoped event and local authority/rights fixture.
